q: Does renewable power lower a Jharsuguda smelter's CBAM figure?
title: Smelters: renewable power and CBAM
short: Not today. Aluminium is charged on direct emissions only, so switching part of the smelter load to renewable power does not change certificates. It lowers your Scope 2 and the cradle to gate figure buyers compare, and indirect emissions may be added to CBAM later.
audience: Aluminium smelters in Odisha contracting renewable power through green open access or round the clock supply deals

p: Annex II of the CBAM Regulation lists aluminium among goods charged on direct emissions only. Electricity is reported, not charged.

ul: Market based Scope 2 under the GHG Protocol, with valid attributes and no double sale.
Product footprints, where power is the largest single item for primary aluminium.
Buyer programmes that set low carbon aluminium thresholds per tonne.

p: Open access approvals, monthly energy accounts and certificates retired in your name. Without them the grid or captive factor applies.
